Advertisement for the post of JRF under DBT Project
Applications are invited for one post of Junior Research Fellow under Ministry of Science &
Technology, DBT sponsored Research Project entitled “Whole Gemone Based Analysis of Mobile
AMR Determinants in Bacterial Pathogens from Fish in North Indian and their Relevance to
Human Pathogens” for 3 years under the supervision of Dr. Ravneet Kaur, Principal Investigator,
Department of Zoology, Panjab University, Chandigarh & Prof. Neena Capalash, Co-Principal
Investigator, Department of Biotechnology, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Position Junior Research Fellow: One
Eligibility Age of candidate should not be more than 28 years.
Essential Qualifications
1. M.Sc. degree in Life Science (Zoology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Microbiology, Biophysics
and Biochemistry) with minimum 55% marks (50% marks in case of SC/ST/OBC). Candidates
with UGC-NET/GATE/ICMR/any other national level examinations conducted by central
government departments and agencies will be preferred.
Fellowship Rs. 31,000/- per month +16% HRA for M.Sc. with NET qualified for 1st & 2nd
Year &
Rs. 35,000/- per month + 16% HRA for 3rd Year
Interested persons who fulfil the above conditions may send their applications to the undersigned on a
plain paper giving details of all educational qualifications, experience, publications and scanned
copies of certificates of qualifications by post by 17/11/2023.
Important:
1. Candidates should necessarily mention their e.mail address and cell phone number in their
CV, so that we can inform them about the date and time of interview.
2. Eligible candidates will be required to appear for interview.
3. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview.
4. The tenure of the above said post is co-terminus with that of the project.
Eligibility for the said post will be determined following the submission of all the requisite documents
by the stipulate date and after checking the original documents at the time of interview
Sd/-
( Ravneet Kaur )
Principal Investigator
DBT Project
Department of Zoology,
P.U. Chandigarh
